name: 3NX-series Protection Droid
description: The 3NX-series Protection Droid was a model of security droid available during the Galactic Civil War. Despite their surprising sturdiness, the droid series was never a top seller, as they had a tendency to complain when shot. At least one 3NX-series Protection Droid joined the crew of a young smuggler at the time of the Iron Blockade.
